production.note: US model years. Porsche's release (aa-2011-911-gt3-rs-4-0) says it "goes on sale in the United States in late 2011"; KBB lists a "GT3 RS 4.0 Coupe 2D" for 2011 (kbb-911-2011-specs) and a "2012 Porsche 911 GT3 RS 4.0 Coupe 2D" (kbb-911-2012-specs; database). Porsche's classic page dates it "911 GT3 RS 4.0 (2012)" (porsche-classic-997-gt3). Limited to 600 units worldwide. The 2012 end year rests on KBB's 2012 listing (database) and Porsche's classic-page heading "911 GT3 RS 4.0 (2012)"; no Porsche US page for model year 2012 was found.

body.note: KBB: "GT3 RS 4.0 Coupe 2D"; Porsche calls it a two-seater.

displacementL.note: 3,996 cc. Supercars.net: "displacement | 3996 cc / 243.85 in³". Porsche: "4.0-liter engine".

drivetrain.note: Supercars.net spec table: "RWD", engine position "Rear, Longitudinal". Automotive Addicts' introduction (aa-2011-911-gt3-rs-4-0): "a 6-speed manual transmission will be the only choice to direct power to the rear wheels."

transmission.note: "Available exclusively with a six-speed manual transmission"

powerHp.note: Porsche Cars North America release (Atlanta, 28 April 2011, reproduced by Automotive Addicts, "[source: Porsche]"). Quote: "It achieves its maximum power of 500 hp at 8,250 rpm." Porsche's classic page: "368 kW (500 PS)" (porsche-classic-997-gt3). Porsche's US arm published 500 hp, used as published. KBB: "500 @ 8250 RPM".

weightLb.note: Standard car: the lightweight parts are standard equipment (coupe, 6-speed manual, the only configuration). Quote: "Equipped as standard with lightweight components such as light but strong carbon fiber sport bucket seats, carbon fiber front fenders and luggage compartment lid, and weight-optimized carpets, the two-seater's ready-for-action weight is just 2,998 lbs with a full fuel tank." KBB: "2998 pounds" (kbb-911-2011-specs). Stuttcars quotes Porsche AG's "1,360 kilograms with a full tank of fuel" (stuttcars-911-gt3-rs-4-0).

sources.publisher: Porsche Cars North America (reproduced by Automotive Addicts, "[source: Porsche]")
